findings.title: The real forge reader accepts the first attestation for a digest without checking its predicate type
findings.retires: The assumption that any JSON attestation stored under the synthetic merge digest proves the Attavo traversal was sealed.
findings.severity: Blocking when the digest has an unrelated attestation—especially when it is first in the API response—because doctor reports the item sealed without an Attavo statement.

findings.title: The merge-group doctor races the workflow that creates the attestation
findings.retires: The assumption that enabling the new proof in merge-group CI guarantees the statement is already readable.
findings.severity: Blocking when the doctor job reads the merge-group digest before the independent coherence workflow finishes actions/attest@v2; the valid merge group fails nondeterministically with a 404.

findings.title: Complete items are silently omitted unless one merge introduced every stage record
findings.retires: The claim that the proof accounts for every merged, fully staged item rather than only the repository's customary single-merge record layout.
findings.severity: Blocking when an item's four stage records reach the branch across multiple merges or direct commits and another item satisfies proof two; merge_introducing_records returns null, the item is skipped, and doctor can report done without checking its seal.
